label: miso9 pjm seam hranchor
definition: miso9 pjm-seam-hranchor: first MISO keeper on current main (picks up the ISO-generic CC-tranche PRs #846/#857, which lift MISO gas to ~208 TWh in 2024 vs stale miso8's 160) PLUS a new structural seam lever — a per-year MEASURED marginal-heat-rate anchor on MISO's PJM NeighborInterface (hr_by_year={2023:11.2, 2024:13.49, 2025:12.18}), derived by derive_neighbor_hr_by_year.py from PJM's own realized RT LMP / Henry Hub (the same method PJM's own seam already uses), replacing the flat 3-year mean 12.3. The flat mean under-priced the PJM hub in dear-gas 2024 (measured 13.49), driving the largest MISO seam to over-import. ISOLATED 2024 test (vs current-main baseline, only the seam constant changed): net over-import 60.3->48.3 TWh, net-interchange duration RMSE 4592->3259 MW, import-hours 97.7->92.8% (actual 90.9%), with the freed load picked up by domestic coal (+6) and gas (+6) toward actual — every metric moved toward actual. Measured price-formation input (rule #12), derived blind to MISO's own flow (rule #11); kept on faithfulness grounds even where a single year's fit worsens (rule #1). PASS C3a mean-LMP (30.8/28.9/39.5 vs ~30.8/30.8/42.9), C3b shape, C4 dispatch-r, C6 governance. OPEN MISSES (documented, not masked — next levers): (1) systematic net over-import persists all years (2023 63.6 vs 37.9; SPP/South seams still flat, un-anchored + import-node level over-serves); (2) 2025 net-interchange sign-flip persists (model +7.5 net export vs actual -19) driven by the 2025 coal over-run (235 vs 192) making MISO long — a coal-offer/merit root cause the 2025 PJM anchor (12.18 ~ flat) doesn't touch (C2 2025 gas -20.6%/coal +22.4%); (3) CT_PEAKER already runs at the ~4% actual reserve level on current main (2.97 TWh / 3.9% CF in 2024) — the task's stale 'CT prices out ~0%' miss is RESOLVED by the CC-tranche PRs; --ct-mustrun-per-plant was tested and REJECTED for MISO (over-forces CT to 18.8 TWh because ct_mustrun_floor_mwh_by_plant sweeps combined-cycle CT-prime-mover EIA-923 net-gen into the CT_PEAKER floor — a rule #1 trap that nudges the import metric toward actual via an unreal CT over-dispatch); (4) scarcity tail absent C3c (0h vs 30/37/88 >$200); (5) C5a CO2 -20% (tracks the domestic under-generation from over-import). Solved per-year (2023/2024/2025 separate processes, merged into one bundle) because a 3-year per-plant MISO LP OOMs at 16 GB on a 15 GB box; MISO backcast has no cross-year dependency, so per-year == combined.
